query:
SELECT 
  c.empresaSlug as unidade,
  c.categoriaRanking as categoria,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN c.metaMensal IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as com_meta,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN c.telefone IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as com_telefone,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN c.pinAcesso IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as com_pin
FROM colaboradores c
WHERE c.ativo = 1 AND c.tenantId = 1
GROUP BY c.empresaSlug, c.categoriaRanking
ORDER BY c.empresaSlug, c.categoriaRanking;
